content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps on key issues. The ROI omits the DRAD file and Complainant's medical records, her leave records, and the FMLA request file with its supporting medical documentation. These are the core documents for the accommodation, leave restriction, and FMLA claims. Dates and facts are also disputed (FMLA request in June vs. August; whether leave was denied or charged LWOP; whether a PIP existed), with no documents to resolve them. There is no testimony from C1, C2, the HR representatives, or the Executive Office Director on the leave restriction. There is no comparator evidence, such as how other employees' leave or telework was handled, even though FE was allowed to telework. The HR voicemail about a planned second PIP and S1B forwarding the EEO email to the office are not investigated. The decision cannot be reliably evaluated without these materials."}
